decision: Owner on every catalog entry and environment, handed over at offboarding
Quarantine (kill switch) of a catalog entry in every environment
Budget alerts by signed webhook
Spend export in FOCUS format
sekisho status reports unmanaged MCP servers and marketplaces, kept on the machine
Market-research gaps placed in releases 2 and 3 (enforced settings, MCP Registry API, ID-JAG, lifecycle, scanners, risk signals; rug-pull detection, session rules, analytics)
agentgateway-only formats stay in the rendered config and ext_mcp; hooks use standard protocols; each bump checks for features leaving open source (risk 13)
Rendered gateway configs stored encrypted; newest 10 versions kept
Controller retries a failed publish after 1 s and re-renders every 30 s
Each route names its environment to extAuthz (x-sekisho-env); the request path is never trusted for it
Spend descriptor names the key extAuthz verified (extauthz.key), not the Authorization header
Spend descriptors carry a charge secret derived from the gateway token; without it nothing is charged
An OpenAI-compatible provider's models must have prices
regex: models must have prices|models need prices

decision: Provider keys rotate in place (PATCH /api/v1/providers/{name}); name and kind never change
A key reaches only its provider's model endpoints: POST-only routes, ai.routes per format, default path prefix for built-in kinds
regex: only its provider.s model endpoints|only the provider.s model endpoints|reaches only its provider

decision: Spend recorded in USD; one display currency per install with an admin-set exchange rate; budgets entered and shown in it
Exchange rates are set by hand in release 1; an opt-in automatic daily rate comes after release 1
